rules: #bigBanner { position: absolute; top: 22%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); text-align: center; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.45s; pointer-events: none; max-width: min(90vw, 640px); }
#bigBanner.center { top: 30%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: min(92vw, 1100px); max-width: min(92vw, 1100px); box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0px 4vw; }

#bigBanner .t { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8) 0px 2px 10px; }
#bigBanner.center .t { font-size: clamp(17px, 12px + 2.1vw, 40px); letter-spacing: 0.16em; padding-left: 0.16em; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; line-height: 1.28; }
#bigBanner .s { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.92; margin-top: 5px; text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 0px 1px 6px; }
#bigBanner { top: 192px; left: auto; right: 16px; width: 260px; max-width: none; transform: none; text-align: right; }
#bigBanner { top: 24px; right: 200px; padding: 10px 12px; box-sizing: border-box; text-align: left; background: rgba(11, 18, 15, 0.85); border-left: 2px solid rgb(152, 132, 83); }

#noticeRail > :is(#bigBanner, #stockNotice, #dawnCard, #hollowPickup, .prop-note-card) { position: relative; inset: auto; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-width: 0px; max-width: none; max-height: none; margin: 0px; flex-shrink: 0; transform: none; text-align: left; border-radius: 0px 0px 3px 3px; padding: 10px 12px; background: rgba(16, 25, 19, 0.95); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.333) 0px 5px 14px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

#noticeRail > #bigBanner { order: 0; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 3px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(132, 145, 115, 0.333) rgba(132, 145, 115, 0.333) rgba(132, 145, 115, 0.333) rgb(215, 189, 117); border-image: none; }
#noticeRail > #bigBanner.show, #noticeRail > #stockNotice.show { transform: none; animation: 0.2s ease-out 0s 1 normal none running noticeDrop; }

#noticeRail > #bigBanner.center, #noticeRail > #bigBanner.center.show { position: fixed; top: 30%; left: 50%; right: auto; width: max-content; max-width: min(92vw, 820px); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); text-align: center; background: transparent; border: 0px; box-shadow: none; padding: 0px; animation: auto ease 0s 1 normal none running none; overflow: visible; border-radius: 0px; }

#noticeRail > #bigBanner.center .t { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 44px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.2em; padding-left: 0.2em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) 0px 2px 16px; }
#noticeRail > #bigBanner.show, #noticeRail > #stockNotice.show { animation: auto ease 0s 1 normal none running none; }
